claim: Controller implements only 7 of 12 spec/registry routes; sync, retry, dismiss, import-existing preview+full have no HTTP surface.
suggested: Add 5 handlers delegating to existing (unwired) GoHighLevelPollService methods, mirroring the 7 existing routes' guard pattern.

claim: Only re-exports 3 Prisma enums; two specs import GhlContact/GhlOpportunity/GhlCustomField from it, causing TS2305.
suggested: Add export type {GhlContact, GhlOpportunity, GhlCustomField} from './gohighlevel/gohighlevel.client'.

claim: saveConnection/updateConfig return the raw Prisma row including secretCipher (encrypted token) to the browser.
suggested: Strip to the safe shape getStatus already builds (L101-121) before returning; extract as a shared private method.

claim: listPipelines ignores tenantId and uses the shared empty-credential GoHighLevelClient singleton; always fails for every tenant.
suggested: Build a per-tenant client like buildGhlClientForConnection in crm.module.ts and inject that factory into the service.

claim: retryHandoff reads handoff.connectionId, a column that does not exist on CrmHandoff, so it always passes null connection and throws a TypeError after mutating the row.
suggested: Look up the connection by tenantId (crmConnection.findFirst({where:{tenantId:handoff.tenantId}})) instead of a nonexistent connectionId FK.

claim: @RequireAddon(CRM_ADDON_KEY) uses a const identifier; addon-gate-registry.spec.ts's scanner only recognizes quoted string literals, so P1b fails for crm_gohighlevel.
suggested: Replace @RequireAddon(CRM_ADDON_KEY) with @RequireAddon("crm_gohighlevel") at all 7 (12 after F1) call sites.

claim: matchExistingCustomer queries customers/externalRefs/users with no tenant predicate, so a GHL lead can be linked to another tenant's customer (IDOR).
suggested: Add tenantId to all 4 findFirst calls and thread tenantId into matchExistingCustomer's signature.

claim: retryHandoff and dismissHandoff take only id and run unscoped findUnique/update, a cross-tenant IDOR once the routes are wired.
suggested: Add a tenantId param from the controller; use findFirst({where:{id,tenantId}}) plus a tenant-checked update. Ship only together with F1.

claim: updateConfig's first-save branch computes defaults for a missing row but unconditionally calls prisma.update, throwing P2025 as an unhandled 500.
suggested: Mirror saveConnection's update-then-catch-P2025-then-create pattern (L139-154), ideally via F3's shared upsert helper.

claim: Write-back is invoked with handoff id undefined on the normal poll path, so a write-back failure on a brand-new handoff is silently swallowed and the R20 backoff never starts.
suggested: Have updateHandoff (L157-173) return the row so runWriteback gets its real id, or requery by the composite key first.

claim: saveConnection's update-then-catch-P2025-then-create pattern races under concurrent saves and drops connectedById on the update path.
suggested: Use a real Prisma upsert with connectedById set in both create and update data.

claim: importExisting delegates to pollTenant, which requires connection.enabled, the opposite of the state a client is in when importing history before enabling ongoing sync.
suggested: importExisting should require only secretCipher, not enabled; add an ignoreEnabledGate option to pollTenant.

claim: previewImportExisting skips the enabled/secretCipher guard pollTenant applies, so it builds a client with an empty token and throws CrmAuthError uncaught.
suggested: Add the same secretCipher guard as pollTenant:222; return {count:0,sample:[]} when absent.

claim: pollTenant discards handle()'s result, so created/linked/needsReview/dryRun/failed in CrmSyncCounts are always zero.
suggested: Capture handle()'s {status} and increment the matching counter.

claim: disconnect clears only secretCipher/status/enabled, leaving tokenLast4/locationName/lastError/attentionNotifiedAt/customFieldIds, so the UI still claims a key is stored.
suggested: Null all 5 remaining fields in the disconnect update's data.

claim: runWriteback hardcodes attempts:0/noteWritten:false, and writeBack() never persists noteWritten:true on success, so retries duplicate the GHL note.
suggested: Add a success-path crmHandoff.update({data:{noteWritten:true}}); pass real attempts/noteWritten into runWriteback (needs F10's requery plumbing).

claim: Re-invoking handle() for a WRITEBACK_PENDING row redoes the full forward path instead of just retrying write-back, firing a duplicate operator notification.
suggested: Short-circuit handle() to runWriteback directly when the row is already CREATED/LINKED.

claim: testConnection on a deliberately DISCONNECTED connection flips status to NEEDS_ATTENTION, incorrectly implying lost access.
suggested: Only set NEEDS_ATTENTION when the prior status was CONNECTED.

claim: Phone match compares the normalized E.164 value against raw stored customer.phone/mobile columns, under-matching whenever stored data isn't already E.164.
suggested: Normalize on read (scan+compare) or add a normalized-phone column/index.

claim: A 429 records lastError but does not skip the tenant until Retry-After elapses, so the next tick re-hits a rate-limited account.
suggested: Persist a nextPollAt-style timestamp from retryAfterSec; skip tenants not yet due.

claim: retryHandoff's opportunity fallback reconstructs from a payload key the dry-run writer never produces, so retried leads lose deal name/value/source.
suggested: Persist payload.opportunity in the dry-run writer, or re-fetch the opportunity from GHL by id on retry.

claim: T51 constructs CrmHttpError with 1 argument instead of the real (status, code, message) contract, then monkey-patches fields after.
suggested: new CrmHttpError(404, "http", "GoHighLevel 404"); drop the manual assignments.

claim: T31/T31b mock ghlClient.listTags() as an array of plain strings, a shape the real client's listTags(): Promise<GhlTag[]> never returns.
suggested: Mock with {id,name}-shaped GhlTag objects.

claim: Only searchOpportunities is wrapped in try/catch; processOpportunity is not, so one failing opportunity aborts the rest of the tenant's poll tick.
suggested: Wrap the processOpportunity call (L246) in its own try/catch, log and continue.

claim: testConnection writes GoHighLevel's raw location country into defaultRegion, bypassing ISO-3166 validation and potentially disabling phone matching.
suggested: Validate the country code before writing defaultRegion; drop the value on failure.

claim: getStatus loads every CrmHandoff row for the tenant into memory just to compute six counts.
suggested: Replace with prisma.crmHandoff.groupBy({by:['status'], where:{tenantId}, _count:true}).

claim: Card 2 is missing the trigger-mode radio, pipeline/stage Selects, and Start-from date input; the Enabled switch is disabled on a stageId that nothing in this file can ever set.
suggested: Build the missing controls per ux-spec, wire via onUpdateConfig like the existing toggles.

claim: Save & test never calls testConnection, the Import button has no onClick, and onRetry/onDismiss are never passed by the container -- four dead controls.
suggested: Wire testConnection.mutate(), wire the Import button to previewImport/importLeads, pass onRetry/onDismiss once F1/F8 exist.

claim: Container reads handoffs?.data, but the API's listHandoffs returns a bare array, so the Activity table is permanently empty.
suggested: Check a sibling list endpoint's envelope convention, then wrap the response in {data:rows} or read handoffs ?? [] directly.

claim: ensureTags fetches the location's entire GoHighLevel tag list on every single handoff, multiplying external API calls against the rate limit.
suggested: Cache the tag-name-to-id map per poll tick instead of refetching per-opportunity.

claim: The poll's budget-exhaustion path writes the opaque string "budget" into the operator-visible lastError field.
suggested: Use a human-readable message instead of the literal string.

claim: previewImportExisting has no wall-clock budget and issues one DB query per opportunity.
suggested: Add the same budgetMs guard as pollTenant; batch-fetch existing opportunityIds per page.

claim: Activity table header is missing the 'When' (relative time) column ux-spec's table layout requires.
suggested: Add a <th> plus a relative-time cell.

claim: The Activity card has no loading or error state; a failed or in-flight handoffs query renders the same 'No leads yet' empty-state text.
suggested: Thread isLoading/isError through props and branch the empty-state message.

claim: The 'Import existing leads' button is visually present but wired to nothing.
suggested: See M15's fix.

claim: The Needs-attention banner is missing the 'Test again' button ux-spec explicitly requires.
suggested: Add a Button calling onCheckNow/testConnection inside the banner.
